transfer.source_configuration: mode of D0-only selected model configurations over the other two tasks' completed registered outer cases; ties by original declared grid order; never use target or source outer-T outcomes
transfer.target_cases: the two pre-registered streams in repeat1/fold1; chosen before reviewing their transfer outcomes
transfer.target_model_fit: source-chosen ridge and XGB configuration, fit on target D0, then replay allowed feedback; no target hyperparameter tuning
transfer.acquisition_parameters: original globally frozen configuration, no search or modification
transfer.claim: internal transfer robustness; all old tasks were previously inspected, not first external validation

later_cohort.target_source: all eligible 2016 rows held out from model fitting, preprocessing fitting, references and acquisition
later_cohort.dtype_definition: source 2014/2015 schema only; coerce target numeric columns to those source types before combining, so held-out values cannot determine preprocessing feature roles
later_cohort.target_label: Charged Off=1, Fully Paid=0, same as old cohorts
later_cohort.eligibility: issue_d year=2016, deduplicate loan ID, finite positive loan_amnt exposure, same frozen 21 decision-time features
later_cohort.local_model_parameters: D0-only 3-fold grid from historical training cohort, exactly as original formal protocol
later_cohort.target_evaluation: prior-cohort acquisition trajectories evaluated on untouched later-year outcomes; no 2016 labels enter replay
later_cohort.label_time_limit: final loan status only; actual label availability dates unknown. Report retrospective immediate-label temporal sensitivity, never strict as-of online maturity validation or actual historical reject counterfactuals.

evaluation_policy: report every fixed method and both streams; retain unfavorable results; no outcome-based data-source substitution
registration_note: freeze before downloading or viewing 2016 outcomes; no new scientific objective beyond the supplied MD section9
